dedupe_keys.name: us biofuel feedstock allocation preparation scripts

description: This Python code estimates how US county-level corn and soybean production supplies ethanol and biodiesel plants. The research collaborators publish scripts for simplifying USDA data, computing distances and allocating biomass, with supporting spreadsheets and serialized distance information. The describing article explains a nearest-county allocation rule that gives larger plants priority, using the 2017 crop census and plant locations. GitHub states GPL 3.0 licensing; the archived Zenodo release carries the broader Other Open label. Public access is free. Coverage is a national feedstock-allocation workflow calibrated to historical inputs, not a record of actual contracts or deliveries. The short README does not document dependency versions or a complete execution procedure, and county-centroid allocation limits spatial realism. A reviewer-assessed use is preparing supply links for biofuel logistics and disruption simulations. data-us-corn-soy-biofuel-plant-feedstock-allocation already catalogues the released outputs, while this record identifies the separate preparation scripts. No code or serialized object was executed.
